title: The Drowned Garden
author: Mara Galloway
blurb: Tamsin Thornbury, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
